input.markdown:
# Wall buildability assessment and mix design

## Conclusion
The supplied material is non-printable for the specified free-standing wall under the calculator assumptions. Elastic buckling governs; plastic stability also fails. The default OPC-required 3DCP inverse search sampled 4,096 candidates and found no feasible design. Returned fallback mixes are not approved production mixes.

## Job and assumptions
Target: 600 mm high, 1,500 mm long wall; two filaments; 25 mm nozzle; printing speed 50 mm/s; open time 60 min. Supplied material: initial static yield stress 3,000 Pa and Athix 1 Pa/s, treated as values at deposition.

Defaults: layer height 12.5 mm; filament width 29.61 mm; 3,000 mm path per layer; no dwell; printing starts immediately after mixing; density 2,100 kg/m³; safety factor 1.5; E/tau_s = 25; free-wall buckling enabled. No additional strength target was requested. The inverse engine used its built-in default search settings; its complete bounds and curing defaults were not exposed in the returned summary.

## Assessment
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Layers / cycle / print time | 48 / 60 s / 48 min |
| Free-wall buckling limit | 17 layers; 212.5 mm |
| Plastic-collapse limit without safety factor | Approximately 423 mm |
| Open time | Pass: 48 min within 60 min |
| Required cycle-time window | Infeasible: minimum 160.5 s, maximum 75 s |
| Plastic stability at current cycle | Initial yield stress >=7,824.59 Pa at Athix 1 Pa/s, or Athix >=2.675206 Pa/s at initial yield stress 3,000 Pa |

The rheology thresholds address plastic stability only and do not resolve buckling. These are deterministic physical calculations, not q50 predictions.

## Default inverse design
No feasible candidate was found among 4,096 samples. The highest buildability-ranked fallback had binder mass fractions OPC 0.78 and limestone powder 0.22, w/b 0.338, s/b 1.13, and PCE 1.42% of binder (product basis). Composition is the rounded tool summary, not an exact batching prescription.

Predicted initial static yield stress: **351 [19, 10,179] Pa**, q50 [q10, q90]. The fallback fails the physical assessment: plastic collapse around 36 mm, required cycle time 474 s versus 75 s allowed. Rheology models provide order-of-magnitude guidance; the Athix interval was not exposed in the returned summary. No claim of training-range compliance is made because range-violation counts were not exposed.

## Published experimental analogue
Primary material-development evidence: SP20-HPMC07-PE1.5, *Printability region for 3D-printable engineered cementitious composites (3DP-ECC)*. DOI: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cemconcomp.2024.105599

Reported composition: OPC/fly ash/silica fume fractions 0.50/0.40/0.10; w/b 0.26; s/b 0.20; PCE 0.20%; VMA 0.07%; fibre 1.50 vol%. Measured static yield stress 3,810 Pa and Athix 15.4 Pa/s. This analogue has not been assessed or validated for the specified wall; confirm material identities and test protocols from the source before replication.

## Recommended next step
Add lateral restraint, return walls, or greater thickness to address buckling, then experimentally evaluate faster structuration, potentially using accelerator, VMA, or lower w/b while rechecking extrusion and open time. Slowing the current schedule alone is insufficient. Verify deposited geometry, fresh stiffness, rheology and full-height stability experimentally; literature-trained correlations do not replace trials.
